basics.name: Jihyeon Jeong
basics.label: Undergraduate Research Intern · Aspiring Backend & Infrastructure Engineer
basics.summary: Undergraduate researcher and aspiring backend/infrastructure engineer focused on system-level optimization of Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS) — the retrieval engine behind vector databases, recommendation, and LLM RAG systems. Hands-on experience across software systems and applied projects, from server infrastructure and vector search to autonomous driving and industrial automation.

research.organization: AISA (Accelerated Intelligent System and Architecture) Research Group, Ajou University
research.summary: Advised by Prof. Young H. Oh. Researching system-level optimization of Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANNS), the core retrieval workload behind vector databases, recommendation engines, and LLM RAG pipelines.
highlights: Studying graph-based ANNS indexes (e.g., HNSW) and vector quantization to improve the throughput–recall trade-off under tight memory and latency budgets.
Profiling ANNS workloads across the full system stack to pinpoint compute- and memory-bound bottlenecks, following the lab's vertical acceleration methodology.
Exploring hardware-aware optimization (SIMD, cache locality, and GPU/NPU offload) to accelerate nearest-neighbor search.
Benchmarking ANNS implementations on standard vector-search datasets (e.g., ANN-Benchmarks) to evaluate recall–QPS trade-offs.
